from pathlib import Path
out=[row[:] for row in grid]
for r,c in matches:
 for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=5
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs/task-c1cc60fd.py'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
s='''def transform(grid):
    shape = {(0,2),(1,1),(2,1),(2,2),(3,0),(3,1),(4,2),(4,3)}
    # Find the colored template, using its top-left corner.
    cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,9)]
    color = grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    minr=min(r for r,c in cells); minc=min(c for r,c in cells)
    template={(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in cells}
    h=max(r for r,c in template)+1; w=max(c for r,c in template)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(len(grid)-h+1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])-w+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in template):
                for dr,dc in template: out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(s)
print(out)
